evidence.claim: Customer C13171 explicitly denies making transaction 3558054 ($55.68).
Policy R2 states that when a customer denies a transaction, it results in BLOCK_CARD + CREATE_CASE.

case.summary: Customer C13171 reported an unauthorized online transaction of $55.68 on card C13171-K2. Investigation confirmed unauthorized card-not-present fraud, prompting the card to be blocked and a case created. Connected card C13171-K1 will also be monitored for secondary risks.

sar.reason: Exposure of $55.68 is well below the $1,000 SAR filing threshold, and there is no evidence of a fraud ring, coordinated attack, or undocumented pattern.
